aboutH2: The Farm Rehab: Holistic Treatment Approach to Addiction Recovery
intro: At The Farm in Stouffville, we believe in taking a holistic approach to addiction recovery. We understand that addiction is a complex disease that affects individuals in different ways. Therefore, we combine state-of-the-art pharmaceuticals, dog therapy, cognitive behavioural therapy and addiction suppression strategies to ensure that we meet the unique needs of each patient. Our approach is tailored to the individual, ensuring that they receive the specific type of treatment they require.

pillars.title: Tailored Addiction Treatment Plan
pillars.body: We understand that every addiction case is different. Our addiction treatment plan is tailored to suit the needs of the individual. Whether the addiction is opiate-based, alcohol-related or drug-related, we have a unique approach designed to achieve measurable results. The program is specifically balanced to cater to patients across a wide age range. Our treatment plan is made up of four elements targeting the mind, emotions, spirit & body, to help patients undo the damage caused by addiction on many levels.

pillars.title: Luxury and Comfort
pillars.body: Our luxurious facility is situated on rural land and overlooks the vast hills of Stouffville, Ontario. The Farm features modern amenities and has both indoor as well as outdoor activities to ensure that leisure time is spent in a welcoming and enriching environment. We offer ten beds within the complex in semi-private rooms, enabling participants to have privacy while in treatment. Our modern furnishings and amenities are designed to make participants feel comfortable and relaxed while they focus on their recovery.

pillars.title: A Unique Treatment Program
pillars.body: Culminating from over three decades of experience and over 1000 successful recoveries, The Farm’s lead practitioner Mr. Yonah Budd has developed a unique treatment program. This program holistically amalgamates components from both scientifically proven treatments as well as spiritual techniques into a blend of holistic, medical and psychological therapy. Our aim is to provide a comprehensive approach that addresses the root cause of addiction, helping patients achieve a full recovery.

overview: The Farm Rehab provides a unique and effective approach to treating addiction. Combining decades of scientific research with spiritual methods, their holistic approach focuses on treating the whole individual, not just the addiction. With a 1:1 staff-to-patient ratio, they provide personalized treatment plans that include evidence-based practices such as cognitive behavioral therapy, addiction suppression tactics, and state-of-the-art pharmaceuticals.

location.heading: The Farm Rehab in Whitchurch-Stouffville, Ontario
location.intro: The Farm is on a quiet rural property on Bloomington Road in Whitchurch-Stouffville, in York Region on the northeast edge of the GTA. Downtown Toronto is about an hour away by car, Markham, Aurora and Uxbridge are around 20 minutes, and Oshawa takes roughly 45 minutes.

cells.v: Call any time; office Mon to Fri, 9 to 5

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does The Farm Rehab cost?
faqs.a: The Farm's profile on recovery.com estimates $19,000 for a 30-day stay, and the final figure depends on the program and how long you stay. The centre's own website doesn't list fees, so call 905-203-2777 or toll-free 1-877-353-2777 for a quote. Financing is available.

faqs.q: How long is the treatment program?
faqs.a: Our treatment program can range from 30 to 90 days, depending on the patient’s needs.

faqs.q: What does a typical day look like?
faqs.a: Every day starts with meditation and goal setting, followed by structured groups such as CBT, psycho-educational, process, boundaries and anger management. Each person also gets at least four to five individual therapy sessions a week, plus gym or yoga, art and music therapy, and free time in between.

faqs.q: Does The Farm offer medical detox?
faqs.a: Yes. The Farm runs a medical detox centre in the countryside outside Stouffville, with medical staff on hand around the clock. Detox usually takes from a few days to a couple of weeks depending on the substance, and afterwards patients are encouraged to move into one of the centre's treatment programs.

faqs.q: What type of addiction does The Farm treat?
faqs.a: At The Farm, we treat opiate-based, alcohol-related, and drug-related addiction.

faqs.q: What is the treatment plan at The Farm?
faqs.a: Our treatment plan is tailored to suit each patient’s specific needs. It is comprised of four elements targeting the mind, emotions, spirit & body, to help patients undo the damage caused by addiction on many levels.

faqs.q: Where is The Farm and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The Farm is at 6482 Bloomington Rd in Whitchurch-Stouffville, a rural part of York Region northeast of Toronto. Most people arrive by car: it's about an hour from downtown Toronto and around 20 minutes from Markham, Aurora or Uxbridge. Your intake date is booked after a free assessment call with the Program Director.

You leave with your own aftercare plan, which can include continued counselling and referrals to support groups. Graduates also join The Farm's lifetime alumni program, with three virtual support groups a week, a 24/7 crisis line to the centre's addiction counsellors and weekly in-house NA and AA meetings with alumni speakers.

faqs.q: Is The Farm private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: Yes, it's a private centre and OHIP does not cover its services. Private insurance is accepted, though coverage depends on your extended health plan, and the centre will give you the paperwork your insurer asks for. You can refer yourself, so there's no need for a doctor's referral.

faqs.q: What amenities are available at The Farm?
faqs.a: Our facility has both indoor and outdoor activities to ensure that our patients spend their leisure time in a welcoming and enriching environment.

faqs.q: What is the experience level of The Farm's practitioners?
faqs.a: Our lead practitioner, Mr. Yonah Budd, has over three decades of experience and has helped over 1000 individuals achieve successful recovery.

faqs.q: Does The Farm use pharmaceuticals in its treatment?
faqs.a: Yes, we use state-of-the-art pharmaceuticals as part of our holistic approach to addiction recovery.

faqs.q: Is The Farm's treatment program scientifically proven?
faqs.a: Yes, our treatment program incorporates components from both scientifically proven treatments as well as spiritual techniques.

faqs.q: Is The Farm's facility situated in a serene environment?
faqs.a: Yes, our facility overlooks the vast hills of Stouffville, Ontario, and is situated on rural land, providing a secluded and serene setting for our patients.
